items.title: AI Agents Are Coming For CTV; It’s Cheaper For Politicians To Buy National Ads Than To Target Texas
items.excerpt: Custom buying agents pair identity data from NBCU and FreeWheel with audience intelligence from Dentsu and Newton to recommend NBCU ad inventory — agentic media buying comes to streaming TV.

items.title: Who Eats The Gap When Agentic Spend Outpaces Proof Of Impact?
items.excerpt: An AI agent can stay inside its budget and still spend too much. And the evidence of campaign performance can still arrive after the money is committed.

items.title: Want an AI-Built MMM You Can Trust? Start With a Thesis
items.excerpt: AI can build a marketing mix model in days; M Squared's Madan Bharadwaj on why AI makes expert judgment in MMM matter more, not less.

items.title: At S4 Capital’s Monks, agents can run autonomously, unsupervised for days
items.excerpt: S4 Capital has started letting AI agents work for days at a stretch with no one watching them, and its digital agency Monks now budgets for tokens and talent from the same pot.

items.title: How Liquid Death is building an AI-native marketing organization
items.excerpt: Benoit Vatere, chief media and digital commerce officer at the brand, explained at Advertising Week how it is using the tech to move faster than competitors.

items.title: TikTok to add AI-powered discovery and one-click checkout
items.excerpt: The social media platform is hoping to capitalize on its role as a product discovery engine by adding a conversational AI agent and simpler checkout.

history_match.title: TikTok Unveils AI-Powered Updates for Advertisers: Driving Discovery, Action, and Measurable Business Outcomes

items.title: Pricing tactics come under scrutiny in the age of AI
items.excerpt: Concern is growing that retailers are using customer data to engage in dynamic pricing, and it is putting more companies on the defensive.

items.title: Google Merchant Center UCP Integration Hub
items.excerpt: Google Merchant Center is rolling out the UCP integration hub in the United States. The UCP integration hub allows you to onboard to UCP program from your Merchant Center account.

items.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
items.excerpt: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

items.title: Ads Uploader: 17.5% of 36,289 Meta ad batches came from AI agents
items.excerpt: By arithmetic on vendor data, about 6,350 agent batches reached Meta in 30 days, about 212 a day. Will agents built by Amazon, Meta and X take over that share?

items.title: TrafficGuard finds up to 34% of clicks on some ChatGPT ads were invalid
items.excerpt: Four hosting and proxy networks reached 25 of 47 advertisers and drove 47% of flagged clicks. Vendor-sourced figures leave open what advertisers were billed.

items.title: Invoca packages AI agents as Google bills missed LSA calls over 20 seconds
items.excerpt: Only 52% of home services calls reach a person, per Invoca's July data, and Google now charges for some of the rest. Can AI agents really change that math?
